title: simplicial-set
description: A presheaf X : Δ^op → Set on the simplex category Δ: a set X_n of n-simplices for each n, with face maps d_i and degeneracy maps s_i satisfying the simplicial identities. The combinatorial skeleton of homotopy theory; a presheaf refined to the indexing category Δ.

indexed-by-simplices.description: the base category is Δ, the finite non-empty ordinals with order-preserving maps

face-and-degeneracy.description: face maps d_i : X_n → X_{n-1} and degeneracy maps s_i : X_n → X_{n+1} satisfying the simplicial identities
